item.title: Coleen Rooney signs Primark deal after I’m A Celebrity success
item.description: Coleen Rooney has agreed a multi-million-pound partnership with Primark to launch an affordable athleisure collection aimed at working mums.

item.title: Robert Aramayo triumphs at BAFTAs as One Battle After Another wins best film
item.description: Robert Aramayo won best actor at the British Academy Film Awards, while One Battle After Another emerged as the night’s biggest winner with six prizes.

item.title: Monaco launches online payments for Pass’Sport Culture
item.description: Monaco has modernised its Pass’Sport Culture scheme, introducing online payments and phone reservations to make access to sports and cultural activities easier for young residents aged 11–25.

item.title: Monaco Aces star Íñigo López de la Osa Franco gears up for 2026 season
item.description: Monégasque rider Íñigo López de la Osa Franco will compete for the Monaco Aces in the 2026 Longines Global Champions League, marking a major milestone in his international show-jumping career.

item.title: Luxury Paris-to-Amalfi train journey launches May 2026
item.description: From 4 May 2026, Belmond’s Venice Simplon-Orient-Express will launch a three-day luxury rail journey from Paris to the Amalfi Coast, combining Riviera scenery, five-star hospitality and exclusive Italian experiences.

item.title: France to see early spring heat after record rain
item.description: After more than a month of relentless rainfall, France will see a sharp rise in temperatures from Tuesday 24 February, with sunshine returning but flood risks and frost concerns lingering.

item.title: Lucky Friday 13th jackpot at Cagnes-sur-Mer Casino
item.description: A local woman defied superstition on Friday 13 February, winning nearly €54,000 on a slot machine at Casino Terrazur during a busy Valentine’s weekend.

item.title: Paris airports call for summer suspension of EU border system rollout
item.description: The operator of Paris’s main airports has urged the European Union to delay the full rollout of its new biometric Entry/Exit System, warning it could cause major congestion during the busy summer season.

item.title: Road changes ahead of Monaco’s 2026 race season
item.description: From late February to mid-July, Monaco will see extensive road closures and parking restrictions as preparations unfold for the Historic Grand Prix, Monaco E-Prix and Formula 1 Grand Prix.

item.title: Hospital and A&E charges to increase in cost-cutting drive
item.description: From March and April, fixed patient charges for hospital stays, emergency visits and costly treatments in France will rise as the government seeks €450 million in savings for the social security system.
